@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'Filter agent: check that each name in a filter names a node of the board'
+---
+## What
+
+The filter agent accepts a statement only when it parses AND each name in it names a node of the board (divergence.md §17, "The loop"). Make one function that does the name check.
+
+- Input: a parsed `FilterExpr` and the board state.
+- Check each `#tag` (a tag slug or a virtual tag), each `@actor` (actor id or the slug of its name), each `$project`, and each column name, against the live board.
+- Output: success, or an `INVALID_FILTER` error with the position of the name, a specific message ("no tag named `urgnt`"), and a corrected example (the nearest name, if there is one).
+- First look at `S/Filter/TaskFilter.swift`, `S/GraphQL/TaskSelection.swift` and `FilterSyntaxError.kanbanError(in:)`. Use the existing name resolution and message style. Do not make a second resolver. The filter of `tasks(filter:)` does not change: a name that names nothing still gives an empty result there.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+
+- [ ] A statement with only known names passes.
+- [ ] An unknown tag, actor or project gives `INVALID_FILTER` with the position and a specific message.
+- [ ] Virtual tags (`READY`, `BLOCKED`, `BLOCKING`, `CONFLICT`, `DELETED`, `DONE`, `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`) pass.
+- [ ] The message gives the nearest name when one is close.
+
+## Tests
+
+- Unit tests in `T/` for each criterion.
+- `swift test` passes with no new warnings. #kanbanviewkit #filter-agent
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    Research (implement step). Facts for the next agent:
+
+    - The name resolution of the filter is in the private `FilterCompiler` of `S/Filter/FilterEvaluator.swift`: `tagTest(named:)` (`VirtualTag(named:)`, then `liveTagSlot(named:)` through `RefResolver.storedRef(for:ofType: .tag)`), `liveSlots(of:named:)` for actors and columns (slug, or slug of the name, of a live node), `isRemoteActor(_:withSlug:)` for an assignee URI of a different board, and `target(of:for:)` for a URL value. To obey "do not make a second resolver", move these lookups to one internal type that `FilterCompiler` and the name check both use.
+    - A parsed `FilterExpr` has no positions. The parser rules (`FilterParser.OrExpr`, `AndExpr`, `NotExpr`, `Atom`) must give the range of each atom, for example as a rule output `{ expression, atoms: [kind, value, Substring] }`. `FilterExpr(parsing:)` can then read `.expression`. Thus the name check gets the text and the parse in one call, and the later cards (^9hqjwt8, ^6rxda32, ^k1s3550) call one function: parse, then check the names.
+    - The message style: add a problem case to `FilterSyntaxError.Problem` and use `kanbanError(in:)`, so the position and the `INVALID_FILTER` text are the same as for a parse error.
+    - No edit distance helper is in this package. FoundationModelsExtras has one, but it is private (`InMemorySessionDirectory+Launcher.swift`). `Trigram.dice` of FoundationModelsRanker is public, but it gives a low score for short slugs (`urgnt` / `urgent` = 2/7), so it is not a good "nearest name" test.
+    - `$project`: plan.md §2.2 and §6.3 removed projects and the `$` atom. `$x` already gives `INVALID_FILTER` from the parser, with the position and a correction to `#x` or `%x`. Thus the "unknown project" criterion is the parse error. No decision is necessary for this.
+
+    BLOCKER: the card and divergence.md §17 conflict with divergence.md Q1 and C1 about `BLOCKING`.
+
+    - The card (acceptance criterion 3) and §17 say that the virtual tag `BLOCKING` passes the name check.
+    - Q1 (DECIDED) removed the virtual tag `BLOCKING`. C1 (DECIDED) says: `#BLOCKING` is an ordinary tag filter, and "Do not add a special error or a reserved name". The code agrees with Q1: `VirtualTag` (`S/Derived/VirtualTags.swift`) has no `BLOCKING` case.
+    - Thus on a board with no real tag `blocking`, the name check that uses the existing resolver gives `INVALID_FILTER` for `#BLOCKING`, and criterion 3 fails.
+
+    Options:
+    - (a) Follow Q1 and C1. The virtual tags are `VirtualTag.allCases` (8 tags, no `BLOCKING`). `#BLOCKING` passes only when the board has a real tag `blocking`. Change criterion 3 of this card, and remove `BLOCKING` from the virtual tag list in §17 (and in the prompt of ^k1s3550 and the vocabulary of ^j48gsq3).
+    - (b) The name check accepts `#BLOCKING` with no tag. This is a special name, and C1 forbids it. The filter `#BLOCKING` still gives no task.
+    - (c) Put back the virtual tag `BLOCKING` (undo Q1 for one board). This is a new card, before this card.
+
+    The work stops here. No file changed.
